description: Plain TypeScript on Node.js (services, CLIs, libraries): strict tsconfig, Vitest and ignore files; pair it with ci-js
notes: Not for framework apps whose scaffold owns tsconfig and tests (Next.js, Expo, Angular): use ci-js there. An existing tsconfig or Vite config wins (Vitest reads vite.config, and a vitest.config would override it). tsc -b --noEmit also checks solution-style tsconfigs (files: [] plus references), where tsc --noEmit checks nothing. vitest run fails until the first test exists: write it.
